user.title: Zendure RestAPI
user.description: Enter the IP address of the Zendure device. {note}

error.cannot_connect: No response from the device. Check the IP address and confirm the local API is enabled (add HEMS in the Zendure app, then exit).
error.no_identity: The device answered but reported neither a serial number nor a device id.

abort.no_identity: The device reported neither a serial number nor a device id.

init.title: Polling and external meter
init.description: An external P1 reader — HomeWizard, YouLess, EcoTracker, Shelly Pro 3EM or a Zendure meter — can feed the controller instead of, or alongside, the Zendure P1 meter. Which one is used is chosen with the Meter source select (default: auto). Leave the address empty to poll no external meter. Readers that do not report the time of each telegram are polled at most once a second, whatever the interval below.

data.external_meter_interval_ms: Milliseconds between external meter polls (100-1000; YouLess only below 1000)
